usage: Used for a school building or school as an institution. It is a very common everyday noun.
Often appears with verbs like "返" (go to/attend), "去" (go to), and "喺" (be at) when talking about daily routines.
Can refer to primary school, secondary school, or school in general; the exact level is usually clear from context.
Natural in both speaking and writing, and it is one of the first education words learners should know.
